answer: Vouching is capped, not free: each established identity may back only a fixed number of newcomers, slots drawn by stake-weighted lottery, and the voucher's own locked balance is slashed when its protege later fails a jury audit. A sybil farm cannot self-certify, so it must buy scarce slots from incumbents who price the risk they carry, the way water sinks into karst instead of beading on a lotus leaf. Each detected clone then burns a bond and the farm's ferrous-denominated entry stake, so cost scales with head count times incumbent price.
